# ADR-035 — Exact-alarm permission requested at onboarding via a system-settings deep link; `USE_EXACT_ALARM` not declared

**Status:** Locked

<!-- Decision text below is verbatim from the pre-split docs/DECISIONS.md table row (2026-09-16). Do not edit a Locked decision without explicit owner approval. -->

Exact-alarm permission (`SCHEDULE_EXACT_ALARM`) is requested during onboarding via a system-settings deep link, and its absence is surfaced as a distinct "reminders may be delayed" state rather than treated as a blockage. `USE_EXACT_ALARM` is deliberately **not** declared: it is auto-granted but Google Play restricts it to alarm-clock/calendar-category apps, and this app is self-hosted and never listed, so the prompt is the honest route (Checkpoint 5, user-approved 2026-08-18)
